capabilities: Select an entire line by clicking its line number
Add or remove single lines with Ctrl/Cmd + Click
Select contiguous line ranges with Shift + Click or mouse dragging
extras: Requires line-number display to be enabled in Settings (Editor - Line numbers); requires Obsidian 0.15.0 or later; README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
problem: Obsidian's editor lacks line-number gutter interactions, so selecting multiple whole or non-contiguous lines with the mouse is awkward.
summary: Gutter-based multi-line selection that lets users select whole lines via line-number clicks, keyboard modifiers, and dragging.
